cases.acceptance: Real page read/write and scan/index equality with independent row values; not a RAM-only substitute
Atomic row/index/locator/catalog commit and crash/reopen, including partial writes and UNKNOWN outcomes
Working set >= 4x buffer, actual I/O witness and bounded buffer/locator/RSS accounting
Pinned snapshot survives eviction, concurrent change, checkpoint and reclamation; no stale physical reuse
Backup/checkpoint/restore at one committed cut; repeated recovery and required corruption rejection
PK/unique/nonunique independent vectors, statement failure atomicity, quota and cancellation
Disk partition routing/pruning and atomic row movement with local index consistency
Disk global unique/nonunique tree; membership/lifetime/row movement/crash at one cut
